blue-ridge-asheville-to-linn-cove-viaduc.title: Blue Ridge · Asheville to Linn Cove Viaduct
blue-ridge-asheville-to-linn-cove-viaduc.slogan: A 229 km loop out of Mount Mitchell
blue-ridge-asheville-to-linn-cove-viaduc.story: High forest, stone walls and America’s best slow road. 229 km round from Black Mountain - plan on about 4 h 24 of riding. It goes by way of Linville Falls, Linn Cove Viaduct and Blowing Rock. The climb of the day is Mount Mitchell. It tops out at about 950 m. The passes are the reason to go.
blue-ridge-asheville-to-linn-cove-viaduc.hero: Blue Ridge · Asheville to Linn Cove Viaduct

sections.advice: This Linville Falls → Linn Cove Viaduct stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.
sections.photoQuery: Mount Mitchell gate Linville Falls Blue Ridge and Appalachians

sections.advice: Linn Cove Viaduct → Blowing Rock food is the reward section in Blue Ridge and Appalachians. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.
